Mr. C.B. won the Nihon Derby. The excited 
crowd was abuzz, talking about how she 
truly is an extraordinary talent capable 
of surpassing even "the Myth."

Unconcerned by such appraisals, Mr. C.B. 
learned that Symboli Rudolf, who had yet 
to debut, was already drawing tremendous 
attention.

Imagining how much she had transformed in 
just one year, Mr. C.B.'s heart leapt with 
excitement.

Meanwhile, the defeated Katsuragi Ace was 
filled with regret, frustrated that she 
had merely served as a foil.

Mr. C.B.'s next goal is the final leg of 
the Classic Triple Crown, the Kikuka Sho.
